svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.
svg.metadata: Snapshot 8293ad0adab0fd5a. Saved 2026-11-10T14:24:38.001Z. Original vector strokes; no external assets.

g.title: Kale
g.desc: Happy birthday, dear. I hope you never run out of reason to smile, courage to chase your dreams, or strength to overcome difficult days. May you heart always be surrounded by warmth, kindness, and genuine happiness.

g.title: zos
g.desc: Happy birthday Trap, Huge appreciation for your endless generosity, constant sponsorship, and always going the extra mile for Arcade and the GC. May your kindness return to you in countless blessings, happiness, and success. Stay awesome and keep shining! ✨
